text:
I don't know if this will help, but during Covid when the embassy was closed for the public we (family member that was there) managed just to give them the documents.
After that I called the embassy to make sure they checked them and when they could be picked up.
In our case this was for the verification of the documents as they don't have apostille in the country.
But maybe like this it would solve the issue with the time limit on the documents and then , once open for the public, they can invite you ?
